Pourtime Privacy Policy

Updated October 1, 2026

Pourtime is a personal drink journal published by Zachary Wilson.

Your drink journal and profile

Drink logs, session history, and your optional name and profile photo are stored on your device. Pourtime does not send these records to its advertising SDK or operate a server for your journal. Device backups may include local app data. You can delete active entries, saved sessions, or your optional profile in the app. Clearing an active log does not delete saved history.

Pourtime does not request weight or biological-sex information. When older records successfully migrate, these fields and derived BAC estimates are removed.

Advertising

Pourtime uses Google Mobile Ads and Google's User Messaging Platform. Advertising services may collect device identifiers, an IP address used to derive approximate location, ad data and interactions, product interaction data, crash logs, performance information, and other diagnostics for advertising and analytics. Some of this information may be linked to a device or used for tracking when permitted. See Google's data disclosure and Google's privacy policy.

Pourtime requests tracking permission where applicable. You can change permission in iOS Settings. Where required, you can revisit advertising consent through Manage Advertising Privacy in the app's Settings. Denying tracking does not prevent logging drinks. The app does not use your drink records, name, or profile photo to target advertisements.

Purchases

Apple processes the optional Remove Ads purchase. Pourtime checks verified StoreKit entitlements and supports restoring purchases. Pourtime does not receive your payment-card information. The advertising SDK is not initialized when a Remove Ads entitlement is detected at launch.

Photos and links

If you choose a profile photo, the app stores a local copy of the selected image. Opening an external link is subject to that website's privacy practices.

Audience and purpose

Pourtime is intended for adults recording their consumption for personal awareness. It does not estimate BAC, impairment, or sobriety and must not be used to determine fitness to drive.
